name: Screens
description: Alpha: gives agents their own screen, a desktop that never touches yours, through the screens service: ostia screen create, token, list and stop, the screen verbs from a sandboxed workspace, a card before an agent's first screen in a workspace, a panel with this workspace's screens, and a phone's screen while its human runs a session they started on the phone (needs the phone-screens permission). Screens stop when their workspace closes or this extension stops.

commands.title: Create a screen for this workspace
Print the agent token of this workspace's screen
Screenshot as JSON with a base64 PNG
Click in the screen
commands.usage: click [--screen ID] [x y] [--button B] [--count N] [--modifiers KEYS] [--down|--up]

commands.title: Drag in the screen
commands.usage: drag [--screen ID] x0 y0 x1 y1 [--modifiers KEYS]

commands.title: Scroll in the screen
commands.usage: scroll [--screen ID] up|down|left|right amount [x y] [--modifiers KEYS]

commands.title: Start a program in the screen
Read a phone screen's accessibility tree
Ask the phone to share its screen
